_comment: Reference template — copy the 'hooks' object into ~/.qwen/settings.json (or .qwen/settings.json for one project), merging with any hooks already there. The commands assume the standard extension install location and need no editing; Qwen runs them through a shell, so $HOME expands. Point them at a checkout instead only if you are developing the hooks. Qwen Code expands neither ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} nor ${PLUGIN_DATA}, so the path has to be literal. 'timeout' is in seconds — Qwen reads a value of 1000 or more as legacy milliseconds. Qwen has no extension-manifest hooks field, which is why this is a settings.json template rather than a plugin-declared hook map.
